why_every_rung_including_the_ineligible_: the selection rule compares the learner against the strongest deterministic baseline, and 'strongest' is only meaningful if the weaker rungs are on the record too. An ineligible rung is recorded with the reason it is ineligible, so a reader can see that the comparison was not narrowed to a rung the learner happens to beat
